labels.lesson.title: Keep the Discussion Moving When It Gets Stuck
labels.section.title: Notice What the Discussion Needs
labels.observation.focus: What is happening? What is still needed?
labels.case.label: Practice example
labels.case.state: No recommendation adopted; no activity held
labels.source.prompt: A community centre wants a 20-minute welcome activity for new members. Help them meet one another and find out about its weekly drawing group. Your group should recommend one activity and explain how it serves both aims. Use the main room and existing paper and pens; do not buy anything.
labels.proposal.maya: We could start in pairs and exchange names and interests.
labels.task.open: How would visitors find out about the drawing group?
labels.reflection.prompt: What was said? What remains to examine?
labels.pause.boundary: A pause does not establish agreement or a motive
labels.traits.boundary: Describe the moment, not a personality
labels.role.rule: A small contribution needs no appointed leader
labels.repair.resources: Clarify · finish a turn · connect · invite
labels.repair.possible: Ask about the missing task link
labels.repair.limit: A question does not itself provide the information
labels.private.prompt: Choose one small move and its purpose
labels.next.title: Next: restart after a pause
